ValidationRule.description: Takeoff GPS must be within 150m of Lot GPS
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), (AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Takeoff_Geotag_Lat__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Takeoff_Geotag_Lng__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Lot_Latitude__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Lot_Longitude__c)), SQRT(((Takeoff_Geotag_Lat__c - Lot_Latitude__c) * 111000)^2 + ((Takeoff_Geotag_Lng__c - Lot_Longitude__c) * 88000)^2) > 150 )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Takeoff GPS out of range — must be on-site
